UnboundLocalError in merge_subqueries optimizer when renaming inner sources

#### Description

The merge_subqueries optimizer is throwing an `UnboundLocalError` when trying to access variables that are referenced before assignment. This appears to be related to the variable scoping in the `_rename_inner_sources` function.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot
from sqlglot import optimizer

# This will trigger the error during optimization
sql = """
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT a, b FROM table1 t1
) sub
JOIN table2 t2 ON sub.a = t2.a
"""

# Try to optimize with merge_subqueries
optimized = optimizer.optimize(sql, rules=[
    optimizer.qualify_tables.qualify_tables,
    optimizer.qualify_columns.qualify_columns, 
    optimizer.merge_subqueries.merge_subqueries
])
```

The error occurs when the optimizer tries to merge subqueries and needs to rename conflicting source names between the outer and inner scopes.
</issue>
